title: Controlled activation evidence schema and preflight gate

activation_boundary.summary: This is not activation and supplies no live activation proof. It defines a future evidence package contract for operator-gated controlled activation stories only.

operator_approval_ref.notes: Approved operator change ticket or signed approval reference; no credentials or approval secrets.

security_approval_ref.notes: Security approval reference for target, risk, rollback, redaction, and emergency-disable scope.

activation_intent.notes: Plain-language future operator intent for the bounded activation story; not proof activation occurred.

smoke_scope.notes: Exact smoke checks to run in future stories, expected results, bounded timeout, and stop conditions.

evidence_retention.notes: Retention policy reference or statement for future activation evidence, including expiry/disposal expectations.

redaction_statement.notes: Statement that the future evidence package is redacted and contains no plaintext secrets, credential values, private key content, certificate material, token values, full DSNs, or production host secrets.

staleness_policy.notes: Future activation evidence expires fail-closed; warnings or best-effort acceptance are not allowed.

redaction_and_secret_hygiene.policy: no plaintext secrets, credentials, private key content, certificate material, token values, full DSNs, or production host secrets in evidence packages, checker output, docs, status, or artifacts
allowed_examples: hashes or digests without secret material

non_goals: No live activation or production activation proof.

No provisioning, production host mutation, migration execution, compose/profile production activation, credential handling, certificate material handling, plaintext fallback, dependency, lockfile, or runtime behavior change.
No acceptance of readiness prerequisites as proof activation occurred.
